newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan buys 750,000 bbls Dec reformate at $25.50.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan buys 750,000 bbls Dec reformate at $25.50.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has bought 750,000 barrels of 95-octane reformate for December at around $25.50 a barrel, an official confirmed on Wednesday.

CPC paid less than $25.50 a barrel for one 250,000 barrels of unleaded 95-octane reformate for delivery in the second half of December and slightly higher for the two 250,000 barrel-cargoes of leaded 95-octane reformate for delivery December 6-20.
All awards were made on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to Keelung or Taichung.
"The price was slightly lower than the last award," said the official, referring to $25.90 it paid in its last tender for two unleaded cargoes for November 21-30 and December 1-15 delivery.
The official said CPC received almost ten offers for the leaded and a similar number of offers for unleaded cargoes in the tender which closed November 5 and was valid until November 7.
